description: Material slot standard. Every material on a game mesh is named M_{character}_{slot}[_{variant}] and the slot decides which shader family renders it in Godot. Families map 1:1 to shaders in addons/spike_character/shaders.

maps.base: Base color, sRGB. Lit-side color. No baked lighting except painted occlusion in deep crevices.
maps.shade: Shadow-side color, sRGB. Hand-authored tint (never a darkened copy of base). Optional; falls back to base * shadow_tint.
maps.ilm: Linear packed control map. R = specular mask, G = shadow bias (0.5 neutral, lower = shadows earlier, painted AO lives here), B = specular size/shape, A = inner-line mask.
maps.normal: Tangent-space normal (OpenGL +Y). Baked from the master sculpt. Fabric weave / mesh detail as a separate tiling detail map.
maps.mask: Linear. Family-specific (face: R = SDF region, G = blush, B = lip gloss; hair: R = highlight strand breakup).
maps.sdf: Face only. Linear single-channel face-shadow threshold map generated by pipeline/tools/face_shadow_sdf.py.
maps.iris: Eye only. Painted iris layers, sRGB.

skin.desc: Soft two-band ramp with warm terminator, no hard specular, subtle rim. Body, arms, legs, hands.

face.desc: SDF face shadow (no normal-based self-shadow artifacts), blush, lip gloss. Does not cast shadows; receives hair shadows.

eye.desc: Layered eye: sclera with lid shadow, parallax iris, pupil dilation, live catchlights.

lash.desc: Alpha-scissor lashes and brows, unshadowed, always dark and crisp.

mouth.desc: Mouth interior, teeth, tongue. Flattened lighting so the mouth never looks like a hole.

hair.desc: Directional (Kajiya-Kay) stepped highlight, strand-broken angel ring, root-to-tip gradient, rim.

fabric.desc: Soft ramp, very low sheen, weave detail. Jersey, shorts, socks, knee-pad sleeves.

knit.desc: Compression knit: slight directional sheen along the leg. Knee-high socks, sleeves.

rubber.desc: Dense matte with a broad soft highlight. Outsoles, knee-pad faces.

plastic.desc: Crisp small highlight. Shoe heel counters, hair clips, buckles.

print.desc: Decal layer for numbers, wordmarks and printed graphics. Slightly glossier than the fabric under it.

outline.method: Inverted hull (front-face culled next pass). Hull direction comes from smoothed normals baked into the vertex color attribute in TANGENT space (so it survives skinning). Vertex color alpha = per-vertex width multiplier painted by the artist (thin at fingertips, lash line, hair tips; 0 inside the mouth).
outline.encoding: rgb = smoothed normal in (tangent, bitangent, normal) basis * 0.5 + 0.5; a = width multiplier

godot_render_layers.note: Character meshes render on layer 1 (world) and 2 (character light rig). Character key/rim lights use cull mask = layer 2 only, so character lighting can be art-directed without relighting the court.
